additional_info.subject: ID0475501-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / RN 170002789] Lost Power Modules CRM:03275000033
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0475501
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-PL SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / RN 170002789
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
Dear Poland Service Team,
After your request and our check, we can see that the PowerConverters are faulty as shown in the screenshot below.
First, check the cables attached to the converters. If they are properly connected, proceed to the next step.
Try swapping the converter that shows the issue with the one beside it. This will help confirm whether the problem lies in the cables or in the converter itself. If the issue remains after swapping, it confirms that the converter is faulty.
In that case, replace the converters :
-8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-PL SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Anass Mezzaoui
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

additional_info.subject: ID0475501-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / RN 170002789] Lost Power Modules CRM:03275000033
additional_info.body:
Hi Szymon,
I checked the charger with RemoteDebug station and I see that the QA11-12 is not closing, in this case, the DC4 is not grouped at all and DC3 is grouped incorrectly and you can see the F:0 for the converters that are not in DC4 which show E52
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
